entities.summary: Vasili Nikolaevich Pankov is a Belarusian former ice hockey player. He played for Yunost Minsk, Augsburger Panther, Slovan Bratislava, Lada Togliatti, and Tivali Minsk during his career. He also played for the Belarusian national team at the 1998 and 2002 Winter Olympics, and multiple World Championships. Pankov was tested positive for 19-Norandrosterone and retroactively disqualified for the 2002 Winter Olympics. After his playing career he turned to coaching.
